titleZh: 暑期游客比价周期拉长，酒店怎么把“比价”变成“下单”
titleEn: Summer guests are comparing longer. How hotels turn "comparing" into "booking"
summaryZh: 比价客人不怕你贵，怕的是他没算明白你这单到底值不值。酒店可以用信息一致性、直订入口、报价理由、咨询承接和客户沉淀五个检查点，把“咨询”接成“订单”。
summaryEn: Guests who compare are not distrusting you; they are waiting for a clear reason to book with confidence. Five checkpoints, online information consistency, a smooth direct booking path, a compelling offer, timely enquiry responses and guest retention, help hotels turn enquiries into bookings.
contentZh:
前台同事晚上交接时说起一件事：一位客人白天打电话问了三遍价格，又问早餐和停车，最后在一家电商平台上截图对比了一圈，说了句“我再考虑考虑”，挂了电话就再没回来。

这不是个例。这个暑假，很多酒店都遇到同一种客人：人不少，咨询也不少，问得很细，下决定却越来越慢。酒店在想，是不是我价格给得不够低？降了价，客人是不是就会订？

价格当然重要，但把眼光只放在价格上，往往解决不了问题。客人不是不想订，而是变得更理性了。在线旅游平台上的房源数以万计，游客在下单前往往要反复比较好几家才做决定。酒店的订单没能跟上咨询量，问题大多不在没流量，而在“把咨询接成订单”的这条链路没有闭环。

先说清楚一个背景：今年的暑期市场整体呈现“量升、价有分化”的格局，不同城市的酒店表现并不一致，有的低线城市量价平稳甚至齐升。这里讨论的是“客人变多了、却比价更狠、下单更慢”这一种常见的经营处境，不代表全国所有酒店都如此。如果你是后一种情况，本文的方法同样值得对照检查。

所谓把“比价”变成“下单”，本质是让精打细算的客人，在比较完之后觉得你这家值得直接订，而不是再回到列表里去比下一家。下面五个检查点，你可以今天就对照走一遍。

一、线上信息是否一致

客人比价，比的不只是价格，还有价格背后的一整套信息。官网、携程美团等平台、地图上的介绍、点评里的描述，如果价格、房型、早餐、政策说法不一，客人第一反应就是“这家不靠谱”，然后划走。

检查方法很简单：用手机把自家酒店在主要平台上的展示页全部打开，逐项核对价格、房型、含早信息、取消政策、地址电话是否完全一致。发现不一致的，当天就改。信息一致是信任的基础，信任是下单的前提。

二、直订入口是否顺畅

很多酒店官网只是“展示用”的，客人在上面看了半天，找不到能直接下单的地方，最后还是回到电商平台。倒不是官网不重要，而是它没有承担起承接直订的角色。

检查方法：模拟客人走一遍官网预订流程，看能不能在几步之内完成一间房的预订，还是中途被卡住、要去打电话、加微信才订得上。直订入口顺畅，不仅能少付平台佣金，更重要的是让“已经决定订你”的客人不用再绕路去别处。

三、报价有没有给客人下单的理由

只会给一个单晚价，是最容易被比下去的打法。客人比来比去，比的就是这个数字本身，数字高他就走。

给精打细算的客人一个“不用再比”的理由，往往比单纯降价更有效：连住有升级，订多晚送早餐，提前预订锁定当天价格，家庭出行给一个含儿童加床的套餐。这些做法没有把单晚价压下去，却让客人的“账”算得更划算，也更愿意当场决定。

四、咨询能不能被及时接住

高峰时段和晚间的咨询，往往是订单流失最集中的地方。客人晚上比完价，想确认最后一个细节，电话没人接、留言没人回，热情就凉了，第二天就到别家订了。

检查方法：看过去一周的咨询记录，高峰和晚间时段的咨询，有没有得到及时、清楚的回复。不需要回答得多华丽，关键是要快、要清楚、要能推动下一步：“您的房型今天还有，我帮您留到几点”比“您再看看吧”有用得多。

五、订过的客人有没有沉淀下来

很多酒店天天忙着接新客，订完的客人却转身就忘了。客人第一次订你，是最容易建立直接联系的时候，错过了，下次他又回到平台里比价，又变成陌生流量。

检查方法：订过房的客人里，有多少进了你自己的客户池，有没有做入住后的回访，有没有在节日或淡季联系过他们。哪怕只是建立一个简单的客户档案，在第二次、第三次预订时，他们就不再是“比价路人”，而是回头客。

如果你发现自己店里在这五个地方有不止一个缺口，不用急着一次全改。本周先从信息一致性查起，这是成本最低、见效最快的一步；再补直订入口；再上报价组合。一步一步把这条链路接起来，咨询才会慢慢变成订单。

关于官网如何承接搜索流量、留住愿意直订的客人，迈创兄弟C&T在[酒店运营提升](https://marvelbros.com/zh/hotel-operation-improvement)的服务页里有更系统的说明，可以对照你自己网站的问题逐项梳理。如果你的酒店也卡在“有人问、没订单”这一环，可以从一次[经营诊断](https://marvelbros.com/zh/contact?type=diagnosis)开始，把五个检查点逐项过一遍，看清楚真正堵在哪里。

客人比价，不是不信任你，是在等一个让他放心下单的理由。你要做的，不是把价格压得更低，而是把这条链路接得更顺，让他在比完所有选择之后，还是决定订你。
contentEn:
At handover one evening, a front desk colleague mentioned a guest who had called three times to ask about the price, then asked about breakfast and parking, compared options on a booking app for a while, said "I will think about it," and never came back.

This is not one isolated case. This summer, many hotels are seeing the same guest: plenty of enquiries, detailed questions, but decisions that keep getting slower. The natural reaction is to think the price is too high and that cutting it will bring the booking.

Price matters, but focusing only on price often misses the real problem. Guests are not refusing to book; they are becoming more rational. With thousands of listings across online travel platforms, travelers often compare several options before deciding. When bookings do not keep up with enquiries, the issue is usually not a lack of traffic but a conversion channel that has not been closed.

To set the context: this summer the market broadly shows rising volume with mixed pricing, and different cities and property tiers are performing differently. Some lower-tier cities are seeing stable volume and pricing, or even growth in both. The situation discussed here, where guests are more numerous but compare harder and decide more slowly, is a common operating condition, not a description of every hotel in the country. If your market is the latter type, the checklist below is still worth reviewing.

Turning "comparing" into "booking" essentially means giving a budget-conscious guest a clear reason to book with you directly, instead of returning to the list to compare another property. Here are five checkpoints you can walk through today.

1. Is online information consistent

Guests compare more than price. They compare the information behind the price. If the official website, OTAs such as Ctrip and Meituan, map listings and review descriptions show different rates, room types, breakfast and policies, the visitor's first reaction is that the property is unreliable, and they move on.

The check is simple: open your property pages on the main platforms on your phone and verify whether the rates, room types, breakfast details, cancellation policy, address and phone number are fully consistent. Fix any inconsistency the same day. Consistent information builds trust, and trust is the precondition for a booking.

2. Is the direct booking path smooth

Many hotel websites exist only for display. Guests browse for a while, find no obvious way to book, and return to a booking platform. The website is not unimportant; it simply has not taken on the role of converting direct bookings.

The check: simulate a guest completing the booking flow on your website. See whether a room can be reserved in a few steps, or whether the guest is stopped, asked to call, or asked to add a contact before they can book. A smooth direct booking path both reduces platform commission and, more importantly, lets a guest who has already decided to book with you complete it without detouring elsewhere.

3. Does the offer give guests a reason to book

Offering only a single nightly rate is the easiest offer to compare away. The guest compares that number and leaves when it is higher.

Giving a budget-conscious guest a reason not to compare further often works better than simply lowering the price: a room upgrade for consecutive nights, breakfast included when booking multiple nights, a rate locked at today's level for an advance booking, or a package that includes a child's extra bed for families. These do not cut the nightly rate, but they make the guest's own calculation more favorable and make an immediate decision more likely.

4. Can enquiries be answered in time

Peak-hour and evening enquiries are where bookings are most often lost. A guest finishes comparing at night, wants to confirm one last detail, finds no answer on the phone and no reply to a message, and cools off. The next day they book elsewhere.

The check: review the past week's enquiry records and see whether enquiries during peak and evening hours received a prompt and clear reply. The answer does not need to be elaborate. It needs to be fast, clear and to move the conversation forward. "Your room type is still available today; I can hold it until evening" works better than "please take another look."

5. Have booked guests been retained

Many hotels focus on new guests all day and forget those who have already booked. The moment a guest first books with you is the easiest time to establish a direct relationship. Miss that moment and the guest returns to the platforms to compare again, becoming anonymous traffic again.

The check: among booked guests, how many have entered your own guest pool, received a post-stay follow-up, or been contacted around holidays or low season. Even a simple guest profile means that on the second and third visit they are no longer a comparing stranger but a repeat guest.

If you find more than one gap in these five areas, there is no need to fix everything at once. This week, start with information consistency, the lowest-cost and fastest step, then improve the direct booking path, then add offer combinations. Connect the channel step by step, and enquiries will gradually become bookings.

For a more complete view of how a website can capture search traffic and retain guests who want to book directly, MarvelBros C&T has a fuller explanation on its [hotel operations page](https://marvelbros.com/zh/hotel-operation-improvement). If your hotel is stuck in the situation of being asked but not booked, a [diagnosis](https://marvelbros.com/zh/contact?type=diagnosis) can walk you through all five checkpoints and show where the real blockage is.

Guests who compare are not distrusting you. They are waiting for a reason to book with confidence. Your task is not to push the price lower but to connect the channel more smoothly, so that after comparing every option, they still choose you.
author: 迈创兄弟C&T
